observations: Single photo shows a silver/grey countertop microwave oven, front three-quarter view.
Control panel on right side with a dial and several push buttons; digital display not clearly legible.
Door has a tinted glass window; no visible cracks or obvious damage from this angle.
A watermark overlay reading 'OLISAEMEKA MAKOL...' is on the image; appears to be a seller/vendor stamp, not a brand on the unit.
No brand name, model number, or rating label is legible anywhere on the unit.
Interior of the microwave (turntable, grill element, cavity walls) is not visible.
No photo of a receipt or warranty card is included despite being mentioned.
Item sits on what looks like a shop display shelf alongside other appliances in the background.
Seller's new message is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.claim: London used microwave working very well
claims.evidence: No power-on test, no display lit, no sound/heat demonstration in any photo.
Interior and grill element not shown in any photo; cannot confirm dual function.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No purchase date or usage indicator visible; age claims cannot be verified from a photo.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Internal/motor condition cannot be assessed from an exterior photo.
No image of receipt or warranty card provided.

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: A verbal assurance with no new photo or video; seller's word alone is not visual proof and is treated as a claim, not evidence.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat (most common fault in used microwaves)
risks.proof: Short video of the microwave running with display lit and a cup of water visibly heating/steaming

risks.risk: Grill function may be absent or non-operational, even if microwave works
risks.proof: Video showing grill element glowing red during a grill cycle
risks.if_unproven: priced as microwave-only, grill not working

risks.risk: Interior may have burn marks, rust, or damage affecting safety/value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the open interior cavity, including turntable and grill coil
risks.if_unproven: priced as if interior condition unknown/poor

risks.risk: Door seal or glass could be cracked or door latch faulty, causing radiation leakage risk
risks.proof: Close-up photo of door seal and a photo/video of door opening and latching

risks.risk: Missing accessories (turntable glass plate, grill rack) common on used units
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out beside the unit

risks.risk: Receipt/warranty claim could be unfounded, no transferable warranty in practice
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual receipt and warranty card with dates
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no warranty exists

proof_requests: Video of the microwave powered on, heating a cup of water, showing timer counting down
Video of the grill function in use with visible heating element
Photo of the open interior cavity and turntable/grill rack
Close-up photo of door seal and latch mechanism
Photo of receipt and warranty card
response.reason: The seller's verbal reassurance adds no new visual evidence, so all functional and condition claims remain unverifiable; the item must still be priced at worst case as not working with grill function unconfirmed.
